validation_findings.evidence: All rectangular plate edges, circular rim edges, and axial seam edges have positive analytic extent.
Every imported edge retains an exact Geom_Line or Geom_Circle representation.
The one full-periodic cylindrical hole wall has one unique axial seam edge with two oriented face occurrences.
The no-processing STEP readback records 1e-7 millimetres, equal to 1e-10 metres, for every vertex, edge, and face tolerance.
All fifteen unique edges have exactly two face uses; the two annular cap loops close against the cylindrical wall and the outer cap loops close against the four side faces.
The centred radius-4 hole stays clear of every outer boundary, so the single closed shell has no tangent contacts, coincident walls, or edge incidence above two.
The hole spans the full 8 millimetre thickness, is 10 millimetres from the nearest outer boundary, and has positive radius and wall thickness; the processing-disabled readback is B-rep valid.

oracle.statement: A 36 by 28 by 8 millimetre box is cut by a radius-4 cylinder centred at (18,14) and extending from z=-5 to z=13, so the cutter crosses both plate caps without a blind termination. The result has one closed outer shell with four rectangular side faces, two annular planar caps, and one inward-facing cylindrical wall: seven faces and nine face-bound wires. Twelve box edges, two circular rim edges, and one cylindrical seam give fifteen unique edges; the eight box corners and two seam endpoints give ten unique vertices. Two face uses per edge produce thirty edge occurrences and sixty endpoint occurrences.
